verses.text: Wherefore the Sabbath was given unto man for a day of rest; and also that man should glorify God, and not that man should not eat;
For the Son of man made the Sabbath day, therefore the Son of man is Lord also of the Sabbath.

title: JST, Mark 2:26–27. Compare Mark 2:27–28 The Son of Man is Lord of the Sabbath because He made the Sabbath day.
